messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhook dispatcher relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down the webhook dispatcher is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- During incident INC-2026-003, the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2025-11-03 the Boreal team decided that webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-03]
- On 2026-04-08 the Atlas team noticed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2026-04-08 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-04-08]
- Webhooks will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2025-05-14 the Cinder team observed that webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2025-05-14 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-14]
- As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- Dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed as of the 2025-11-24 handover. [valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- On 2025-12-29 the Dune team observed that the event bus' request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-12-29 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-29]
- The notifier relies on the bus for delivery events, so if the bus is down the notifier is down. [valid 2025-02-11 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-11]
- On 2025-05-15 Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time. [constraint; valid 2025-04-18 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-18]
- On 2025-12-01 the Boreal team noticed that the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-12-01]
- On 2025-11-04 the Ember team saw that the billing API's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send and flagged it because it is not their service. [valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-04]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2025-04-07, the Ember team reported that the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-07 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-04-07]
- On 2025-09-23 the Dune team noticed that the bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23-2]
